title: A catalogue-guided Brougham on Prairie Avenue
items: An additional empty Brougham follows the 1893 Studebaker catalogue design, with a shaped roof, curved door, fine step supports and recessed dark rear quarters. The existing unidentified carriage remains nearby. Fine detail remains nearby, with a lighter version of the same carriage in the distance.
The individual vehicle, dimensions, finish and stop are reconstructed. Photographic refinement continues; boarding and driving are unavailable.
